notes.title: Xbox One Controller on Win10 Fix!
notes.notes:
A new update is ready to download for you. This version has a fix for the Xbox One controller issue on Windows 10. There is an option in game settings now to enable or disable using the Xbox One controller on Win10. You might need to disconnect your controller the first time in order to enable that option in settings and you should be good to go afterwards.

The levels with missing time information have been fixed and overall this build includes a few more minor bug fixes.

Have a great time being a Ninja!

notes.title: Big Update!: Version 0.8
notes.notes:
The BIG update is here! This update introduces you to the game story!

In this version:
 - Game story for the first three chapters
 - Enhanced game menus
 - Highly polished level structures
 - Enhanced game graphics
 - New combat features for Kuro
 - The first two boss fights
 - Enemy introduction cutscenes
 - New music
 - Full leaderboard integration for the new levels
 - Game hints
 - 3 Difficulty levels for the game
 - Various bug fixes

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Shadow Blade: Reload
notes.notes:
Shadow Blade: Reload is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Kuro is a young man on his quest to become the Shadow Blade. He must seek the teachings of the last remaining ninja master. You will guide him through challenging levels, around countless traps, sneaking past enemies or right over their dead bodies. You have to be fast, be stealthy, be aware of your environment. You have to be a Ninja!
